replies.body:

replies.subject: RE: RFQ-2026-014
replies.body:
Hi Pavan,

For the RSC boxes we can do Rs 44.50 a kilo on 5-ply and Rs 40.50 a kilo on 3-ply. All the other items stay at our 2025-V5 contract prices. Transport to the plants will be billed separately, at actuals.

ISO 9001 and FSC certified (certificates on file with you, ISO valid till Feb 2027). BCT reports with every lot and we test ECT in-house. Capacity 3.5 lakh boxes a month, lead time 12 days, zero quality complaints this year. Buffer stock and both plants as today. We print up to two colours. Recycled content declared; mill certificates not usually shared. Payment 60 days is fine.

Thanks,
Suresh Patil
Sahyadri Paperpack
